# Enable the full Bluetooth stack
CONFIG_BT=y
CONFIG_BT_HCI=y
CONFIG_BT_HCI_ACL_BUF_COUNT=4
CONFIG_BT_HCI_ACL_BUF_SIZE=1024
CONFIG_BT_SETTINGS=y

# Enable BLE Mesh with provisioning and relay support
CONFIG_BT_MESH=y
CONFIG_BT_MESH_RELAY=y
CONFIG_BT_MESH_PROV=y
CONFIG_BT_MESH_CDB=y
CONFIG_BT_MESH_PB_ADV=y
CONFIG_BT_MESH_PB_GATT=y
CONFIG_BT_MESH_CFG_SRV=y
CONFIG_BT_MESH_RPL=y

# Disable mutually exclusive Friend and Low Power features
CONFIG_BT_MESH_FRIEND=n
CONFIG_BT_MESH_LPN=n
